traces.source_license: US federal government court filing; public record
traces.citation: Case 1:25-cv-10413, Document 1-1, affidavit page 13, paragraphs 35–38, Figures 1–2 (PDF page 16).
traces.criterion: Reach the cited endpoint through the exact published funding outpoint and spend, without traversing the endpoint.
limitations: One-hop public trace; no general efficiency conclusion.
The filing's paragraph 38 uses intermediary-wallet language; the two cited txids directly connect in recorded chain data. No missing hop is invented.
The printed short suffix 9j9D differs from the full address suffix Pj9D; use the full address and txid, independently checked.
The exchange label is a published historical assertion, not proof of present control or account ownership.

traces.reason: Full addresses are redacted and txids are absent. No chain edges or endpoint-call metric can be verified from this filing alone.
